csv_project_name: Design for Mesa Arts Center Repurposing and Place-Making
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Mesa is seeking a qualified consulting firm or team to provide a Design Concept Report for the Mesa Arts Center (MAC) Arroyo Repurposing and Place-Making project. The proposed improvements are as follows: This project will consist of conceptual design services for the re-purpose of the Arroyo water feature and the re-design of the pedestrian corridor into a multi-use public space. The project is located between the Mesa Contemporary Arts Museum and Mesa Art Center Theatres, from Main Street to First Avenue. Design services will include programming, concept design (including master plan, concept exhibits, presentation boards, and renderings), phasing plan, cost estimating and participating in stakeholder and public meetings. Concept design to emphasis visual and technology integration, interactive and public art, lighting, flexible/movable spaces, city event space, outdoor dining, theatre programming, improvement of pedestrian circulation and re-imaging the landscape design.
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, Urban Studies/Planning/Design, Graphic Design/Public Art
